sections.executive_summary: The quant stack is producing usable learning evidence at 13 weekly runs, but forward paper tracks still underperform ^FTSE after costs: primary ai_judgment at −21.5% excess vs benchmark (+1.8%), control rules at −30.2%, while momentum_grace is shallow but least bad at −2.6%. Primary beats control on cost-adjusted excess, so the AI overlay is not the main drag versus rules churn, but neither track clears the success criterion. Archived signal backtests remain constructive (28d buy +3.0% excess, n=232) while portfolio simulation and live books diverge sharply—selection and churn, not raw signal rank, dominate. The single biggest modelling gap this week is assessment-model timing calibration: trajectory_evidence shows 1w directional hit_rate 44.97% (n=378) with realization_lag (within_4w realization 92.98%, median 1w)—opinion changes fire before price confirms. Secondary forensics: loser_snapshot_cards top_failed_families quality (9), dividend (6), garp (6) on 56 cards.
sections.performance_diagnosis:
- Primary ai_judgment: excess_after_costs −21.47% vs ^FTSE (+1.81% benchmark); total_return −19.66%; cost_drag 24.61% (£246 costs on 36 trades); equity_marks 24 — moderate mark thickness, enough for direction but thin for knob inference.
- Control rules: excess_after_costs −30.24% vs benchmark (+2.91%); cost_drag 32.02% (£320 on 54 trades); equity_marks 16 — heavier churn amplifies cost drag versus primary.
- Experimental momentum_grace: excess_after_costs −2.55%; cost_drag 2.91% (£29 on 5 trades); equity_marks 21 — low activity limits learning value despite best headline excess.
- Primary beats control by +8.8pp after costs (verdict: underperforming market, beat_control true) — AI-judgment selection reduces churn damage but does not offset selection losses.
- Current ai_judgment epoch (from 2026-08-26): excess_after_costs −1.83% vs −21.47% full-period — recent window less bad, but epoch has only 6 equity_marks and 2 trades; too early to call improvement.
- Cost drag is material on primary/control (25–32%); marks are sufficient for weekly review but not for confident knob priors (knob_calibration readiness.ready_for_priors false on both tracks).
- No recommendation to auto-apply decision-review knobs — all three reviewed tracks show applied: false with empty proposed_changes.
sections.signal_backtest_findings:
- Signal backtest (run_count 13): 28d buy excess +2.99% (n=232); 7d buy +1.75% (n=513); 28d avoid −1.22% excess (n=204); 7d hold +1.05% (n=1553). History is seeded (run_count ≥ 2).
- Historical analysis (run_count 13, 5 observation weeks): 7d overlay:buy smoothed excess +0.89% (n=453); 28d screen vs overlay excess nearly identical (+2.85% vs +2.86% smoothed). Research overlay adds little vs screen at these horizons.
- Offline simulation (13 periods): research_overlay excess −14.83% vs static_levels −0.64%; momentum_grace sim −0.35% — high-turnover overlay path destroys value in sim, consistent with live cost drag.
- Trajectory evidence: labeled_event_count 487; prediction_hit_rate_by_horizon — 1w 44.97% (n=378), 4w 51.88% (n=266), 8w 47.06% (n=119), 12w unscored. weeks_to_realization: median 1w, within_4w_rate 92.98% (n=285). Model focus candidates (assessment-model hypotheses, not live-screen mutation):
  - hold→buy 1w: positive_rate 0.2609, mean −0.74%, n=23 — flip did not match next-week price.
  - signal_unchanged 1w: positive_rate 0.3743, n=350 — stale opinions also miscalibrated at 1w.
  - strong_buy→buy 1w: positive_rate 0.40, n=15 — downgrade timing weak.
  - 1w horizon_hit_rate 44.97% — directional sign not beating chance.
  - 8w horizon_hit_rate 47.06% — still below chance at longer horizon.
  - realization_lag: 1w hit 44.97% but within_4w realization 92.98% — timing/conviction delay candidate.
- Loser snapshot cards: card_count 56; cohort_counts avoid 43, failed_buy_alumni 13; top_failed_families quality 9, dividend 6, garp 6, risk 4, cheapness 3. Sample pattern: avoid-tier names (e.g. AAL.L, AML.L) would flip on conviction ≥0.35 while still failing quality/dividend/garp families.
- Chart outcome review (observe-only): verdict mixed_no_terrible; stop_hit 0, terrible 0; 19 well_timed, 18 underwater, 6 giveback. Well-timed: MEGP.L (+12.3%). Weakest: TPK.L (−8.6% underwater). Timing context only — no knob or scoring experiments from chart crossings alone.
- Exclusion universe: recommended_step u2 (“Exclude avoid + timing wait”); readiness.ready_for_priors true (12 week_pairs); cumulative_exclusion_alpha +0.003377 on u2 (u4 negative at −0.006506).

sections.system_gaps:
Probe answers (JSON evidence only):

1. Is the learning consumer seeing paid-for research? FTSE apply layer is fully wired (61/61 buy-tier, 20/20 strong_buy wired, 0 unwired). euro_depth focus_library has 18 memos for 47 buy-tier names but 17/18 are thin_or_zero_body — research spend is not reaching consumable verdict quality on the expansion market.
2. Would a new market inherit the same miss? Yes — sp500 shows filing_ready false, learning_ready false, screen_stale true (last_screen 2026-08-16, 7 unique_days) while observe_snapshots 12 exist; stale observe clock can repeat without produce/publish fixes.
3. Which green counters hide zero quality? weekly_ops remaining $44 and ladder_research executed=1 mask euro_depth memo thinness (17/18 zero-body) and sp500 screen_stale; live_committed 74/74 with verdict looks green but is FTSE-only.
4. File existence vs freshness? dedupe_skipped_count 45 with reason fresh_memo — rememo_backlog_count 0; dedupe blocks refresh even when body quality is poor (focus_library evidence).
5. Observe clocks on ingest-healthy markets? sp500 has 12 observe_snapshots but screen_stale true — learning series stopped while archive exists.

Flags: one medium flag — observe_clock_stale (layer: learning_clock) on sp500; hidden by healthy ingest/observe snapshot counts and unused weekly_ops budget ($44 remaining), not by missing files.

Healthy-counter challenge: memo_file_existence_is_not_quality_or_freshness — euro_depth memo_count 18 reads as coverage progress, but 94% thin/zero-body means learning_ready would still be false if assessed; filing_parity_is_not_learning_ready applies to sp500 (filing_ready false despite 12 snapshots).
sections.proposed_experiments:
1. [scoring] Trajectory timing/conviction delay probe for hold→buy and realization_lag keys — offline replay with 1w vs 4w confirmation gates on n=487 labeled events; expected learning value: test whether deferring tier upgrades until within_4w realization (92.98% rate) improves 1w hit_rate from 44.97%.
2. [scoring] Quality-family gate counterfactual on avoid-tier loser cards (quality n=9, dividend n=6) — simulate blocking opinion-flip triggers (“passes quality family currently failed”) for sample AAL.L/AML.L patterns; expected learning value: quantify false-upgrade risk before live filter design.
3. [offline_sim] Exclusion ladder u2 prior replay on ai_judgment rebalance_log — “Exclude avoid + timing wait”, cumulative_exclusion_alpha +0.003377, 12 week_pairs; human gate, not auto-apply; expected learning value: validate archive alpha converts under T212 costs before shadow promotion.
4. [paper_knobs] Human-run ftse-exclusion-ladder-replay spawn-shadow for step_id u2 — readiness.ready_for_shadow_spawn true, primary_return_delta +5.67%; expected learning value: forward observe u2-filtered book vs parent without engineering PR for spawn itself.
5. [paper_churn] Archive hold-vs-swap probability strand — exit_timing_near_miss hold_closed 277 (72.6% recovery) vs swap_closed 288 (replacement_outperformed 140/288); expected learning value: calibrate rotation aggressiveness before live exit_timing_cohorts mature.

DEFER (deferred triggers): entry_dca cadence analysis (revisit when closed_episodes ≥ 12); hypothesis_outcomes thesis thresholds (revisit hold_closed_with_thesis ≥ 8); knob prior live apply max_positions 5 / min_conviction 0.0 (revisit when ready_for_priors true and shadow endurance confirms); momentum_grace knob retune (revisit via ana-20260728-04 when exit_shadow closed ≥ 10); N58/N59-style entry-timing probes (revisit ldr-20260823-03 archive-lab replay completion); auto-spawn exclusion shadows or decision-review --apply (human gate only); live assign_signal / N3 screen mutation from transition keys.
